vision.quote: We are deeply committed to empowering India’s un-served and under-served communities… our mission is to promote inclusive growth through accessible, need-based financial solutions.
vision.quote_source: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Annual Report FY25, Corporate Overview. The bank phrases it as “Seizing Tomorrow” — building a mass-market bank that earns trust consistently (MD & CEO letter, AR FY25).

pillars.label: Secured pivot
pillars.text: Grow secured to 50%+ — housing, MSME, vehicle, gold — to de-risk MFI cycles and lower credit cost.
pillars.tag: 43.5% in Mar-25 vs 30.2% a year ago

pillars.label: Phygital inclusion
pillars.text: Hello Ujjivan (India’s 1st voice-visual-vernacular app) + video KYC + WhatsApp + UPI — high-touch + low-cost.

pillars.label: Resilience first
pillars.text: GNPA 2.18% NNPA 0.49% PCR 78% + floating provision ₹181 Cr + CRAR 23.1% — buffers before growth.
pillars.tag: Credit cost 2.45% FY25 incl. ₹46 Cr accel.

pillars.label: Granular funding
pillars.text: Deposits ₹37,630 Cr (+20% YoY) — CASA 25.5%, retail + CASA ₹26,676 Cr, LCR 120%.

vision.oneline: Ujjivan makes aspiration bankable where formal credit was absent — “the bank for the aspiring Indians” is the promise; phygital distribution is the delivery.

multiples.label: Multiples-Based
multiples.note: P/S, P/E, P/B, Price/Deposits vs peers/history · +3.2%

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread DCF — 7-year forecast via Bank template, Revenue Growth 14.3% (vs 5Y hist 19.5%, Wall St 3Y 17.9%), Net Margin 21.8%→19.9% (vs 5Y 14.8%, Wall St 3Y 21.5%), Discount Rate 10.0%, Exit Multiple 1.8x P/S. Multiples-Based Value from P/S, P/E, P/B, Price/Deposits etc. vs peers/history. Intrinsic Value = AlphaSpread selected method (DCF for Ujjivan SFB). History: typically traded at 41–59% undervaluation over 5Y vs 47% today — in line with history.

local_crosscheck.note: Local filings cross-check (residual income Ke 12.5% → ₹78; Fwd P/E 14× → ₹68; Fwd P/B 1.6× → ₹64; blended ₹70 → buy ₹56) sits well below AlphaSpread DCF ₹120.48 — local model is more conservative on NIM compression + credit cost; AlphaSpread Bank template assumes margin holds near 20%.

trends.title: Secured pivot de-risks the book
trends.body: Secured share 30.2% → 43.5% in one year (+13.3 ppt) — housing + MSME + vehicle + gold. Target 50%+ — the filings call this “resilience before growth”.
trends.cta: → Watch secured % + GNPA in micro buckets

trends.title: Granular deposits fund the pivot
trends.body: Deposits ₹37,630 Cr (+20% YoY) — CASA 25.5% + retail TD — LCR 120% + CRAR 23.1%. Jun-26 deposits ₹45,668 Cr (+21% YoY) show stickiness.

trends.title: MFI stress & CGFMU cushion
trends.body: GNPA 2.18% / NNPA 0.49% PCR 78% + floating ₹181 Cr — but FY25 credit cost 2.45% (incl. ₹46 Cr accelerated). ~49% of micro book under CGFMU guarantee.

trends.title: Phygital at scale
trends.body: Hello Ujjivan (voice-visual-vernacular) + video KYC + WhatsApp + UPI — serving 700+ outlets, 24,903 staff, 27 states. Applied for Universal Bank licence (2025).

trends.title: Inclusion runway + Secured TAM
trends.body: India — mass-market credit + affordable housing + MSME: Ujjivan’s TAM is domestic, not export. FY25 disbursements ₹23,464 Cr (flat) but Q1 FY27 ₹7,444 Cr (+39% QoQ) shows secured-led bounce.

big_messages.label: Diversification
big_messages.text: “Secured book at 43.5% from 30.2% in a year — the de-risking is deliberate. Growth without resilience is not growth.”
big_messages.source: — MD & CEO letter AR FY25 + BSE Apr-25

big_messages.label: Funding
big_messages.text: “Deposits +20% YoY, CASA +15%, LCR 120%, CRAR 23.1% — the balance sheet funds the pivot.”

big_messages.label: Universal bank
big_messages.text: “Applied for Universal Bank licence (2025) — phygital + trust + track record as the application.”

flags.evidence: GNPA 2.18% / NNPA 0.49% PCR 78% · credit cost 2.45% FY25 (incl. 46 Cr accel.) · 56% unsecured
NIM 8.8% FY25 -> 7% steady-state as secured 50%+; yield 18.5% -> 17.4% mix-driven
C/I 62% FY25 -> 67% Q1 FY27 · phygital + 700+ outlets + Hello Ujjivan investment
CASA 25.5% (₹9,595 Cr) vs AU ~35%* · bulk TD 29% · retail + CASA 70%+ needed
PCR 78% + floating ₹181 Cr (1% of loans) · ~49% micro under CGFMU · watch SMA / PAR 4.5%

bottom_line.core_idea: Not a corporate bank — mass-market inclusion with phygital distribution at ₹51k ticket.
bottom_line.hidden_insight: Watch credit cost vs NIM — disbursement growth is vanity, PCR is sanity.
bottom_line.what_breaks: GNPA >2.5% + C/I >67% with NIM <8% -> RoA slips under 1%.
bottom_line.open_question: Hold NIM 8%+ and credit cost <2% through secured 50% and still land 15% ROE?
bottom_line.takeaway: Don't chase 13x -> own inclusion, wait cycle price.

forecast.note: Shares flat at ~194.8 Cr (BV ₹35.1) — CRAR 23.1% gives buffer, no dilution assumed (Bull at 25% growth could need capital if loan-book CAGR >20%). Bear = MFI credit cost stays high + NIM compresses to ~8% + derate to 6.8×. Bull = secured 50%+ + CGFMU cushion + Universal Bank licence optionality, P/E held at 12.1×.

takeaway: Ujjivan doesn't sell loans — it sells aspiration made bankable where formal credit was absent, and the filings say the next chapter is secured 50%+ (housing + MSME + vehicle + gold) + phygital distribution + Universal Bank optionality — originated in 700+ outlets, underwritten in Bengaluru, serving the aspiring Indians.
method_footer: Filings-only portrait + AlphaSpread valuation. AR FY25 + BSE 30-Apr-2025 results (Total income ₹7,201 Cr, PAT ₹726 Cr, GNPA 2.18%/0.49%, CRAR 23.1%, deposits ₹37,630 Cr, loan book ₹32,122 Cr, NIM 8.8%, RoA 1.6% RoE 12.4%) plus Q1 FY27 disbursements ₹7,444 Cr (+39% QoQ). TTM figures from screener.in/company/UJJIVANSFB/ (Price ₹62.7, MCap ₹12,215 Cr, P/E 13.5×, P/B 1.79×, BV ₹35.1, 52W 43.8–73.9, TTM PAT ₹906 Cr). Valuation via AlphaSpread (https://www.alphaspread.com/security/nse/ujjivansfb/dcf-valuation/base-case): DCF ₹120.48 (7yr Bank template, Rev 14.3%, Margin 21.8→19.9%, Discount 10%, Exit 1.8x P/S, 47% undervalued vs ₹64.21) + Multiples ₹64.69 (1% undervalued) → Intrinsic ₹120.48 → Buy 20% MOS ₹96.38.
